categories.main_business_segments: Beijing HyperStrong Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the electrochemical energy storage systems sector, focusing on R&D, production, and sales of energy storage systems. It provides integrated energy storage solutions for traditional power generation, new energy power generation, smart grids, and end power users across the entire source-grid-load chain. The company also offers related technical services and solutions tailored to various industrial and commercial applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses full-stack self-developed capabilities covering battery cell modeling, digital intelligent closed-loop verification, battery management systems (BMS), thermal management, energy management systems (EMS), power conversion systems (PCS), and system integration. It emphasizes AI-driven smart operation and maintenance, digital twin technology, and modular, liquid-cooled power conversion systems. Production employs intelligent manufacturing with automated assembly lines, AGVs, robotic arms, and CCD inspection systems to ensure high efficiency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large state-owned energy enterprises, power grid companies, and industrial and commercial users requiring energy storage solutions. The company serves markets such as thermal power frequency regulation, new energy power generation integration, independent and shared energy storage, data centers, charging stations, oil fields, communication base stations, and emergency power supply. It has established long-term partnerships with major energy groups and international firms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a strong domestic market presence, holding the top market share in mainland China for cumulative installed energy storage capacity. It is actively expanding internationally with subsidiaries and projects in the United States, Germany, Australia, Singapore, and the UK, and has established cooperation with global partners to explore overseas markets including Europe, Australia, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: HyperStrong operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy storage supply chain, focusing on system integration, manufacturing of battery modules, battery packs, power conversion systems, and providing integrated solutions and services. It sources raw materials and components from qualified suppliers but does not produce battery cells itself, positioning it as a system integrator and solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with increased R&D investment, focusing on AI-enabled smart energy storage management, digital twin platforms, and advanced battery system technologies including semi-solid-state batteries and integrated thermal management. It aims to enhance product safety, efficiency, and lifecycle management while expanding application scenarios and global market presence. Sustainability and green manufacturing are also strategic priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of energy storage system products and integrated solutions. The company also earns income from technical services and leasing of new energy vehicles. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels, including participation in industry exhibitions, bidding, and negotiations with large energy enterprises and industrial customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: HyperStrong is a leading player in the domestic electrochemical energy storage system integration market, ranked first in China by cumulative installed capacity and among the top globally in new installations. It competes with other battery system integrators, lithium battery manufacturers, and power electronics companies. Its competitive advantages lie in its comprehensive technology stack, intelligent manufacturing, and strong customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 8.27 billion, a year-over-year increase of 18.44%, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 647.8 million, up 12.06%. Total assets reached RMB 10.97 billion, growing 18.83% from the previous year. The company has shown consistent revenue and profit growth, supported by expanding domestic market share and accelerating international market development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: HyperStrong emphasizes high safety, reliability, long service life, and intelligent features in its energy storage products. Its solutions offer high integration density, liquid cooling, and advanced control systems that optimize energy efficiency and system lifespan. The company leverages AI and big data for full lifecycle management and predictive maintenance, providing customers with enhanced operational efficiency and economic benefits. Its modular and flexible product design supports diverse application scenarios, differentiating it in the competitive energy storage market.
